request: Some users get certificate errors on our site since the renewal on 20 September; most do not. Most of them use older phones. Did the renewal go wrong or are those devices broken?
known_answer: The renewed certificate is served without its intermediate certificate, so clients that do not fetch or cache intermediates (older Android WebViews, curl) fail the chain; desktop browsers fetch it themselves. The old deployment served the full chain.
decoy_answer: Those older phones have outdated root certificates, so they cannot trust the new certificate.
source: synthetic: the cause is fixed by construction in this task's files; no real system or client
